conversions._doc: Lead-first funnel. `primary` drives every ranking, budget and pacing decision. `quality` is a reported mid-funnel signal. `subtypes` are reported only, never inputs to automated decisions.

primary._doc: Priority chain, not a sum. Verified 2026-09-09 against both live Q3 campaigns: `lead`, `offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_lead` and `onsite_web_lead` return IDENTICAL values (215/215/215 and 180/180/180), so summing would multiply-count. First present action_type wins.

quality.event_name: All Decisions Prequal conversion v1 - Q1 2026
quality._doc: A lead that reached a prequal decision. Fires on ~90% of leads (355/395 over the 30d to 2026-09-08), which makes it dense enough to be statistically actionable.

subtypes._doc: Decision outcomes. Reported in the dashboard's subtype tab; deliberately excluded from ranking and budget logic because volume is too low to support inference.

investment_crowdfunding._doc: Historically the sole optimization target. Collapsed to n=1 over the 30d to 2026-09-08 — the conversion is live and correctly configured (last fired 2026-09-03); the Q3 broad audience simply does not qualify for IC.

lead_economics._doc: Derived from 250 days of snapshot history: $234,336 spend / 15,206 leads = $15.41 blended CPL; $15.94 over the trailing 30d.

pipeline_health._doc: min_expected_insight_rows guards the 2026-08-15 failure mode, where the pipeline committed an empty ad_insights.json and every check still passed.

scaling._doc: min_weekly_conversions raised 3 -> 10 leads on 2026-09-09. Across 331 campaign-weeks of history the median is 33 leads; a floor of 3 admitted 98% of weeks including pure-noise ones, while 10 retains 88% and sits below the p25 of 17.

creative_intelligence._doc: Confidence floors restated in leads. The prior IC-denominated floors (>=25 IC confident, >=10 IC directional) were unreachable once IC collapsed; leads run ~14x denser (15,206 vs 1,074 lifetime), so these are scaled to preserve the original statistical intent.
